+def merge_security_definition(
+    existing: Dict[str, Any], new: Dict[str, Any]
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    # Merge OAuth2 flow scopes of two security schemes with the same name,
+    # so that schemes declared with different scopes are not lost
+    existing_flows = existing.get("flows")
+    new_flows = new.get("flows")
+    if not isinstance(existing_flows, dict) or not isinstance(new_flows, dict):
+        return new
+    for flow_name, new_flow in new_flows.items():
+        existing_flow = existing_flows.get(flow_name)
+        if not isinstance(existing_flow, dict) or not isinstance(new_flow, dict):
+            existing_flows[flow_name] = new_flow
+            continue
+        existing_scopes = existing_flow.setdefault("scopes", {})
+        existing_scopes.update(new_flow.get("scopes", {}))
+    return existing
+
+
+def merge_security_schemes(
+    target: Dict[str, Any], source: Dict[str, Any]
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    for name, definition in source.items():
+        if name in target:
+            target[name] = merge_security_definition(target[name], definition)
+        else:
+            target[name] = definition
+    return target
+

+            )
+        else:

     return security_definitions, operation_security
